about_the_game:
The Illgari have come. Savage wolf-men have razed your home, and now, they’re hunting you. Playing as Jill, a young girl torn from everything she’s ever known, you flee into the dark wilderness—only to find yourself truly alone. But not for long.

Your desperate escape leads you to a band of lost children, each scarred by the same horrors. Together, you must survive the nightmare that is GrimmVale. The relentless Hag Witch drives the Illgari forward, but even she cowers before the greater terror lurking in the shadows.

Forge friendships, uncover long-buried secrets, and explore the vast and dangerous world of GrimmVale—from the whispering woods of Sapling Grove to the scorching sands of the Golden Desert. Along the way, you’ll make allies of gods, fae, beastfolk, and beings beyond imagination. But beware—every choice you make shapes not just your fate, but that of everyone who follows you.

🔹 Survive & Protect – Craft, fight, and strategize to keep yourself and your newfound family safe.

🔹 Unravel the Mystery – The Hag Witch is just the beginning. Darker forces lie in wait.

🔹 Explore a Living World – Solve puzzles, uncover ancient secrets, and carve your own path.

🔹 Forge Unbreakable Bonds – Who will stand by your side when the wolves come again?

The Illgari are always watching. The darkness is never far. Can Jill survive the horrors of GrimmVale?

short_description: GrimmVale is a story-rich RPG set in a dark world of twisted fairy tales. Chased from her home, separated from her parents, and pursued by Wolves and Witches, Jill must gather allies and seek out the sources of magic to bring down the dreaded Wolf King, and regain the peace and family she has lost.
